ra: Tonantzin is a Nahua deity within the pre-Columbian Mesoamerican religious complex represented by the hub collective.
Mam is a Maya ancestral/earth figure within the pre-Columbian Mesoamerican religious complex represented by the hub collective.

Our Lady of Guadalupe is the textbook case of Catholic-Mesoamerican syncretism, her Tepeyac shrine identified by indigenous devotees with the Nahua mother-earth goddess Tonantzin; Sahagun records pilgrims calling the site Tonantzin (Brading, Mexican Phoenix).
